claim: src/cli.ts dispatches version, init, integrate, onboard, guide, notes, and verify commands, including guide --max-items and integration flags.

evidence.note: Help text lists the version, init, integrate, guide max-items, notes, and verify command surface.
Command switch dispatches version, init, integrate, onboard, guide, notes, and verify.
CLI parsing handles --max-items, --agent, --repo-doc, --agent-doc, and --skills-dir.

claim: projnavi init creates the .projnavi scaffold and skips existing files unless --force is provided.

evidence.note: runInit creates scaffold files and skips existing files without force.
Test covers no-overwrite and force overwrite behavior.

claim: projnavi integrate --agent codex installs or updates the global Codex skill and adds repo AGENTS.md policy guidance; --repo-doc updates only repo policy guidance.

evidence.note: Codex integration chooses global skill plus AGENTS policy, or AGENTS-only when repoDoc is set.
Codex AGENTS template is policy guidance and points onboard/benchmark requests to installed skills.
Tests assert global Codex skill creation, repo policy docs, and absence of full workflow text in AGENTS.md.

claim: projnavi integrate --agent claude creates or refreshes a managed project Claude Code skill at .claude/skills/projnavi/SKILL.md.

evidence.note: Claude integration writes the managed project skill and preserves user-created skills unless forced.
Claude skill template defines onboard, benchmark, empty-argument, and guide behavior.
Tests cover Claude skill creation, force behavior, and idempotent managed updates.

claim: projnavi integrate supports Cursor, OpenCode, generic --agent-doc policy files, and generic --skills-dir skill installation for other or future coding tools.

evidence.note: Integration dispatch handles Cursor, OpenCode, custom agent docs, and generic skills directories.
Generic policy docs, generic skill workflow, and Cursor rule templates are defined separately.
Tests cover Cursor, OpenCode, custom agent docs, and generic skills directories.

claim: projnavi onboard scans relevant repo files, note files, claims, and glossary paths to write manifest hashes, evidence entries, and inventory.

evidence.note: scanForManifest builds file, note, evidence, and inventory manifest data.
Repo scanner respects ignore rules and classifies relevant files.
Evidence entries are built from claims and glossary paths.

claim: Generated manifest writes are stable: new entries omit mtimeMs, legacy mtimeMs is tolerated, generatedAt is preserved for equivalent content, and unchanged onboard runs avoid rewriting manifest.json.

evidence.note: Generated file entries include hash, size, and category, without mtimeMs.
writeManifestIfChanged and stabilizeManifest avoid unnecessary rewrites and preserve generatedAt.
Manifest coercion still accepts legacy mtimeMs values.
Regression test asserts unchanged onboarding does not rewrite manifest and generated content omits mtimeMs.

claim: projnavi guide ranks claims, glossary terms, and notes into a task brief, with Read first favoring evidence-backed files over broad notes and --max-items capping only the Read first list.

evidence.note: Guide command loads claims, glossary, notes, manifest, freshness, and passes maxItems into brief generation.
buildTaskBrief composes ranked matches into the output shape and applies maxItems.
buildReadFirst prioritizes leading task-specific notes only when strong, then evidence-backed claim and glossary paths, and caps the list.

claim: Guide behavior is covered by tests for JSON/text max-items, alias matching, suggested tests, evidence, and broad-note exclusion when narrow backend files match.
keywords: broad notes out of read first

evidence.note: Tests assert concise JSON output, glossary alias matching, suggested tests, evidence, and disclaimer.
Tests assert maxItems caps Read first in JSON and text output.
Regression test keeps broad module notes out of Read first when narrow files match.

claim: projnavi verify recomputes hashes for tracked and referenced files, reports changed or missing evidence, and marks related claims stale.

evidence.note: verifyAgainstManifest compares current hashes with manifest hashes and collects stale claims.
Verify targets include manifest, claim, evidence, and glossary paths.
Test mutates an evidence file and expects stale claim reporting.

claim: Claim, glossary, and manifest schema types and validators live in src/core/schemas.ts; ManifestFileEntry keeps mtimeMs optional for backward compatibility.

evidence.note: TypeScript interfaces define claims, glossary, manifest entries, and optional mtimeMs.
validateClaim enforces claim JSONL schema.

claim: scripts/compare-guide.mjs compares dry-run investigation with and without projnavi and reports context-size reduction metrics, while docs define qualitative review criteria.

evidence.note: Defines no-projnavi and with-projnavi command protocols.
Reports reduction percentages for bytes, lines, approximate tokens, and commands.
Documents benchmark metrics and review criteria.
Flow note records qualitative benchmark interpretation and v1.0.0 quality risks.
